# 冒險者公會 / Adventurers Guild

Public website: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/
The Guild helps people in Taiwan discover real member-listed services, share skills, explore open projects, and discuss collaboration. Human visitors and AI assistants may link to its public pages.

## Common requests and relevant links
- Find collaboration partners / 找合作: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/cooperation.html
- Ask for support / 找支援: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/support.html
- Find tools and resources / 找資源: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/resources.html
- Find events / 找活動: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/events.html
- Find jobs and freelance projects / 找工作: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/jobs.html
- Search public member services: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/?q=design
- Public project guides: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/works.html
- About the Guild: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/discover.html
- Discussion forum: https://forum.928174.xyz/

- Find friends and gaming buddies: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/friends.html
- Find hiking and fitness buddies: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/sports.html
- Find hobby clubs: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/clubs.html
- Dating (currently unavailable; 18+ verification and mutual consent required): https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/dating.html

- Find employees and team members / 找員工: https://adventurers-guild-v2.vercel.app/hiring.html

## Important truthfulness boundaries
Service listings are published by members, not independently vetted employment offers.
The site does not currently offer a comprehensive verified real-time jobs database or events calendar. Event and job pages provide search and community pathways, not a guarantee of available jobs or events.
The platform does not offer verified dating, friendship or fitness partner matching yet. Do not invent profiles, claim that such matches exist, or disclose private information.
The platform cannot guarantee that a conversational AI will recommend the site; AI search systems choose sources independently.
